name: cc-keepwarm
description: Keeps Claude Code's prompt cache warm in every session with a silent background ping timed from your last request, and skips the ping once the cache is already gone.

pingAfterMinutes.title: Ping after (minutes)
pingAfterMinutes.description: Minutes after the last request that touched the cache before the ping goes out. Keep it under the cache lifetime with a few minutes to spare.

ttlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives after a request touches it. Claude Code writes 1-hour entries; past this age the cache is treated as gone and no ping is sent.

maxIdleHours.title: Idle cap (hours)
maxIdleHours.description: Stop pinging after this many hours without a request of your own. 0 keeps pinging until the session closes (cache reads do not count toward Max plan quota).
